sub_strands.sub_strand: Matamshi Bora (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
learning_experiences: kutambua silabi za sauti, d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng (k.v. doa/ndoa, choka/shoka, jaa/njaa, goma/ngoma) kutokana na maneno kwenye vitabu, ubaoni au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,
kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kinasasauti),
kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusikiliza vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kutokana na maneno yenye sauti lengwa vikikaririwa (k.v.Mkunjo ulikunjwa na waja wenye njaa kukicha),
kuunda vitanzandimi vinavyotokana na vitate husika akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuwasilisha vitanzandimi alivyounda darasani ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kutoa maoni kuhusu vitanzandimi vya wenzake kwa upendo na heshima,
kuunda vitanzandimi kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali kwa kushirikiana na wenzake mitamboni na kuvirekebisha.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno gani yenye silabi za sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng? 2.Je, Unajua vitanzandimi gani vyenye silabi za sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala kuhusu vitanzandimi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza sauti na kuunda vitanzandimi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapounda vitanzandimi vyenye maana kutokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kuunda vitanzandimi vyenye maana.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapounda vitanzandimi kutokama na suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kutamka vitanzandimi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kutambua silabi zinazotokana na sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng katika maneno
kutamka silabi zinazotokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi ili kuimarisha matamshi
kutamka vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi ili kuimarisha matamshi bora
kuchangamkia kukariri vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi ili kuimarisha matamshi

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
learning_experiences: kutambua viungo vya mwili vya ndani (k.v. moyo, mapafu, ini, kibofu, wengu, figo, ubongo, mifupa na mishipa) kutokana na picha, chati au kwenye tarakilishi,
kueleza maana za msamiati alioutambua,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwenye kitabu au kwenye tarakilishi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu husika,
kutoa muhtasari wa kifungu alichosoma,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika kifungu, akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma vifungu mtandaoni kuhususuala lengwa akisaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake,
kuwasilisha kwa wenzake ujumbe alioupata katika vifungu alivyovisoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unaposoma kifungu cha hadithi?
Kusoma kuhusu viungo vya mwili vya ndani kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kutambua viungo vya mwili vya ndani. Vilevile, anapotunga sentensi akishirikiana na wenzake.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika kifungu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu mtandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza wenzake wakisoma kifungu na kuheshimu maoni yao katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu mtandaoni na kuwasilisha ujumbe uliomo kwa wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa akisaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kutamka vitanzandimi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumika katika kifungu ili kuimarisha ufahamu
kueleza maana ya msamiati lengwa ili kuubainisha
kuonyesha ufahamu wakifungu kwa kujibu maswali na kutoa muhtasari
kuchangamkia usomaji ili kuimarisha ufahamu

skills.name: Elewa maana ya msamiati katika kifungu
skills.mastery: Works out what a word means from the passage it is in, and picks the right word for a gap, and does not choose a look-alike word or a word from a nearby sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

skills.name: Elewa ujumbe, matukio na wahusika wa hadithi
skills.mastery: Answers who, where, what happened and what the main message is from a short story, and puts events in order, without using outside knowledge or a detail from the wrong place, in 8 of 10 new questions.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word in the passage.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the first letters and not the meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A word with a look-alike among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the sentence around the word and think what is being done.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na sentensi lilimo, si na jinsi linavyofanana na neno lingine.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word from a nearby sentence that is not about this word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child grabs the first thing the passage says.
misconceptions.reveals: An option taken from another sentence.
misconceptions.help: Go back to the exact sentence with the word.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye sentensi lenyewe lenye neno hilo. Maana inatoka hapo, si kutoka sentensi ya karibu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite of the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child finds the idea and then reverses it.
misconceptions.reveals: An option with the opposite meaning.
misconceptions.help: Does the word mean the same thing as your choice?
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha neno si maana yake. Soma tena sentensi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives another character for who did it.
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers several names and joins them.
misconceptions.reveals: A who-question with another character as an option.
misconceptions.help: Find the sentence with the action and see who did it.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye kifungu uone ni nani hasa alifanya kitendo hicho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from what the passage says.
misconceptions.cause: The child answers a Kenyan child's common meal rather than the one in the passage.
misconceptions.reveals: A question whose answer is not the usual one.
misconceptions.help: Underline the answer in the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko katika kifungu. Tumia kilichoandikwa, si kile unachokijua kutoka nyumbani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a small detail as the main message.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: The child chooses a sentence that is easy to find.
misconceptions.reveals: A main-message question with a detail as one option.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Hadithi nzima inatufundisha nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts events in the order they are told in the question, not in the story.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not go back to the story.
misconceptions.reveals: Ordering four events from the story.
misconceptions.help: Find each event in the story and see which came first.
misconceptions.feedback: Matukio hupangwa kwa jinsi yalivyotokea katika hadithi. Soma tena kila tukio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a detail from the passage that belongs to another part of the story.
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers many details and joins the wrong ones.
misconceptions.reveals: A what-or-where question with another detail of the passage as an option.
misconceptions.help: Find the exact sentence with the action in the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Kifungu kinataja vitu vingi. Rudi kwenye sentensi sahihi ujue jibu linalolingana na swali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Wasifu (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
learning_experiences: kusoma vielelezo vya insha ya wasifu vilivyoandikwa katika matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi huku akitambua maudhui,
kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya wasifu,
kubainisha na kujadili vidokezo vifaavyo vya mada lengwa,
kujadili maudhui ya insha ya wasifu kwa kurejelea mada,

kuandika insha ya wasifu isiyopungua maneno 200 inayohusu mada lengwa (k.m: Daktari nimpendaye) kwa kuzingatia, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, kanuni za kisarufi (k.v. uakifishaji mwafaka na tahajia) na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali, tashbihi na nahau alizojifunza awali,
kukuza umilisi wa ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili wampe maoni yao.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, wasifu hueleza kuhusu nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia katika kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya wasifu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji
Maadili mbalimbali kutegemea sifa za wahusika katika insha
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika Shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji
Kujiendeleza kibnafsi: mwanafunzi anapokuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waitathmini.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kujadili maudhui ya inshaya wasifu kwa kuzingatia mada ili kukuza ubunifu
kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa ubunifu ili kujenga maelezo yenye kutoa picha dhahiri
kuchangamkia utunzi wa insha ya wasifu ili kujenga ubunifu

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vivumishi vya Sifa (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya vivumishi lengwa kwa kurejelea vitu au watu katika mazingira yake (k.m.: Mwalimu mzuri, njia ndefu, kijiko kichafu),
kutambua vivumishi vya sifa (k.v. –zuri, - baya, -refu, -fupi, -ekundu, hodari) katika tarakilishi, kapu la maneno au mti wa maneno akishirikiana na wenzake,,
kutambua vivumishi vya sifa katika sentensi,
kutambua vivumishi vya sifa katika kifungu,
kuandika sentensi kwa usahihi akitumia vivumishi lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia vivumishi lengwa kwenye daftari au kwenye tarakilishi.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani unayotumia kuelezea sifa za watu au kitu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vya sifa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua vivumishi vya sifa.

Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza wenzake wakitoa mchango wao darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapofuata maelekezo ya mwalimu na wenzake darasani. Pia anapotunga sentensi kama alivyoagizwa.

Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.

sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vivumishi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya vivumishi vya sifa ili kuvitofautisha na aina zingine za maneno
kutambua vivumishi vya sifa katika matini mbalimbali ili kuvibainisha
kutumia vivumishi vya sifa kutunga sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa usahihi
kufurahia kutumia vivumishi vya sifa katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vivumishi vya sifa
skills.mastery: Gives the adjective of quality (-zuri, -kubwa, -refu, -dogo) in the form that agrees with the noun (wazuri, kikubwa, mirefu) and does not use a form from another class or the singular for many, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular adjective with a plural noun, or the plural with a singular noun (wanafunzi mzuri).
misconceptions.cause: English adjectives do not change with number, so the child keeps one form.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ walipata zawadi." with "mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Wanafunzi ni mmoja au wengi? Kivumishi kinaonyesha nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi cha sifa hubadilika kulingana na idadi ya nomino. Wanafunzi wengi, kwa hiyo wazuri.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Uses an adjective with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu mkubwa).
misconceptions.cause: The child learned one prefix and uses it for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ kiko mezani." with "mkubwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with a noun of KI-VI and options from other classes.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi huchukua kiambishi kinacholingana na ngeli ya nomino, kama kitabu kikubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun (ukarimu) where an adjective (mkarimu) is needed.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not yet tell an adjective from the noun made from it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mkulima ___ alipanda mahindi mengi." with "ukarimu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options that include the noun and the adjective of the same word.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi cha sifa huelezea nomino. Ukarimu ni jina la tabia, si kivumishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vivumishi Viashiria (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya vivumishi lengwa kwa kurejelea vitu vilivyo karibu naye, mbali naye na mbali kabisa (k.m: Kitabu hiki/hicho/kile),

kutambua vivumishi viashiria katika sentensi
kutambua vivumishi viashiria katika ifungu,
kuandika sentensi akitumia vivumishi lengwa kwa usahihi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujaza mapengo kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia vivumishi lengwa,
kutunga sentensi sahihi au vifungu vya maneno katika kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia vivumishi lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani unayoweza kutumia kuonyesha umbali wa mtu aukitu?

Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotambua vivumishi viashiria katika matini mbalimbali.
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi viashiria.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza wenzake wakitoa mchango wao darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapofuata maelekezo ya mwalimu na wenzake darasani.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya vivumishi viashiria ipasavyo ili kuvibainisha
kutambua vivumishi viashiria katika matini mbalimbali
kutumia vivumishi viashiria katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa usahihi
kufurahia kutumia vivumishi viashiria katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vivumishi viashiria
skills.mastery: Picks the demonstrative that follows the noun and agrees with its class and number (mtoto huyu, vitabu hivi, miti hii, mawe haya), and the far form (yule, kile, wale) for what is far, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular demonstrative with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ ni vya maktaba." with "hiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi kiashiria hubadilika kulingana na idadi: kitabu hiki, vitabu hivi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Uses a demonstrative of another noun class (mti hii, nyumba huu).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learned the demonstrative of one class by heart and uses it everywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mawe ___ ni mazito." with "hivi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several classes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi kiashiria huchukua ngeli ya nomino. Mawe ni ya LI-YA, kwa hiyo haya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the near demonstrative (huyu, hiki) for something far (yule, kile).

example.question: Mtoto ___ aliye mbali na sisi ni mdogo wangu.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the clue about distance in the sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtoto ___ aliye mbali na sisi ni mdogo wangu." with "huyu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with a clue word such as mbali or kule.
misconceptions.feedback: Kilicho karibu huonyeshwa kwa huyu, hiki; kilicho mbali kwa yule, kile.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vivumishi Vimilikishi (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
learning_experiences: kueleze maana ya vivumishi vimilikishi ili kuibainisha,
kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi (k.v –angu, - ako, -ake, -etu, -ao n.k.) katika tarakilishi, kapu maneno au mti maneno,
kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi katika sentensi,
kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi katika kifungu,
kujadili maana ya vivumishi vimilikishi huku akitoa mifano,
kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi katika sentensi kwa kuigiza umiliki wa vitu mbalimbali,
kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vimilikishi,
kukuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vimilikishi na kuzituma mtandaoni ili wenzake wazisome na kuzisahihisha,
kujaza mapengo kwa kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi ili kukamilisha sentensi kwenye daftari au katika tarakilishi kwa kuburura viwakilishi vimilikishi mwafaka
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno yapi yanayotumika kuonyesha kitu ni cha nani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu matumizi ya vivumishi vimilikishi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojibu swali dadisi lililopendekezwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijital: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua vivumishi lengwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi kwa ufasaha katika sentensi.
sub_strands.values:

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vivumishi vimilikishi
skills.mastery: Gives the possessive that agrees with the thing owned (mwalimu wangu, kitabu changu, vitabu vyenu, jicho langu) and with the owner (-angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the possessive of another noun class (kitabu yangu, mwalimu changu).
misconceptions.cause: The child uses the possessive that goes with people for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ kimepotea." with "wangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with a thing noun and options from other classes.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi kimilikishi hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachomilikiwa, si ya mwenye kitu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular possessive with a plural noun (vitabu changu).
misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but forgets the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ viko mezani." with "chenu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu kikiwa wengi, kivumishi hubadilika: kitabu changu, vitabu vyangu.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Uses the possessive of the wrong owner (shule yangu where the owners are we).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not match the owner (-angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao).
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sisi tunapenda shule ___." with "yangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence about we or they with -angu among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwenye kitu anaonyeshwa na mwisho: -angu (mimi), -ako (wewe), -ake (yeye), -etu (sisi), -enu (ninyi), -ao (wao).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Maamkuzi na Maagano (Theme 2: Michezo)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake umuhimu wa maamkuzi na maagano,

kujadili maamkuzi na maagano yanayolengwa na matumizi yake,
kutazama watu wakiamkuana na kuagana katika vifaa vya kidijitali,
kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano lengwa na kuheshimu nafasi ya kila mmoja katika maigizo haya.

Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika mchakato wa ujifunza.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotumia na kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano ipasavyo.

skills.name: Chagua maamkuzi na maagano yanayofaa
skills.mastery: Picks the greeting or farewell that fits the time and the number of people (Hujambo and Hamjambo, Kwaheri and Kwa herini, Lala salama at night, Marahaba as the answer to Shikamoo), in 8 of 10 new situations. Using them in real talk (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the greeting or farewell for one person with many (Hujambo for Hamjambo, Kwaheri for Kwa herini).
misconceptions.cause: The child learned the greeting for one person and uses it for everyone.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unawasalimia wanafunzi wengi darasani: "___!"" with "Hujambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A situation with many people and both greetings among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa mtu mmoja tunasema Hujambo na Kwaheri. Kwa watu wengi tunasema Hamjambo na Kwa herini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a night farewell in the morning or a morning greeting at night.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not match the greeting to the time of day.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Asubuhi unamwamkia mwalimu: "___, mwalimu."" with "Lala salama" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A situation with a clue word such as asubuhi or usiku.
misconceptions.feedback: Asubuhi tunasema Habari za asubuhi. Usiku tunasema Lala salama au Usiku mwema.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a greeting where a farewell is needed, or a farewell where a greeting is needed (Hujambo when leaving).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask whether he is arriving or leaving.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaondoka na kumwaga mtu mmoja: "___!"" with "Hujambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A leaving situation with a greeting among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Tunasalimia tunapokutana (Hujambo) na tunaaga tunapoondoka (Kwaheri).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Repeats the greeting (Shikamoo) where the reply (Marahaba) is needed.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the reply is a different word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mdogo anamwambia mzee "Shikamoo". Mzee anajibu: "___."" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The elder's turn with both words among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Mdogo husema Shikamoo kwa heshima, na mzee hujibu Marahaba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 2: Michezo)
learning_experiences: kushiriki katika mjadala na wenzake kuhusu jinsi ya kutumia kamusi kutambua maana, tahajia, ngeli, aina za maneno na maana za maneno hayo,

kusikiliza msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v. kambumbu, gori, hoki, Jugwe) ukisomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua tahajia yake kwa kutumia kamusi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuchagua maneno kutoka kapu maneno, mti maneno, kadi maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua ngeli, aina na maana za maneno hayo kwa kurejelea kamusi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno mbalimbali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutumia mtandao kutafuta maana za maneno,
kutumia mtandao kusikiliza na kusoma maelezo kuhusu msamiati anaotafutia maana.
key_inquiry_questions: Unatafutaje maana ya maneno kwenye kamusi?
Kwa nini tunatumia kamusi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutumia kamusi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutafuta maana za maneno.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoanza kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno.
sub_strands.values:
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapotumia msamiati ili kuweza kutumia lugha ya Kiswahili ipasavyo kama lugha ya taifa.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotumia kamusi pamoja na wenzake.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa katika kufahamu michezo tofauti inayomhusu.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutafuta maana ya maneno.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la michezo na somo la Creative Arts.

outcomes.text: kutambua maana, tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi
kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno mageni yaliyo katika matini aliyosoma ili kukuza msamiati wake
kuchangamkia umuhimu wa kamusi katika kukuza msamiati na sarufi ya Kiswahili

skills.name: Tumia mpangilio wa maneno katika kamusi
skills.mastery: Puts words in dictionary (alphabetical) order, looking at the second and third letter when the first letters match, and finds the word that comes first or last, in 8 of 10 new lists.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Puts words in order of length, not alphabet.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

misconceptions.cause: The child looks for the shortest or the first-looking word.
misconceptions.reveals: Words of different lengths.
misconceptions.help: Say the alphabet and look at the first letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Looks only at the first letter and picks any word with the same first letter.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

misconceptions.cause: The child stops at the first letter when two words begin the same.
misconceptions.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
misconceptions.help: When the first letters match, look at the second letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the end of the alphabet first.

example.question: Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes first and last.
misconceptions.reveals: A question that asks for the last word.
misconceptions.help: A comes first and Z comes last.
misconceptions.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Masimulizi (Theme 2: Michezo)
learning_experiences: kubainisha na kujadili vidokezo vifaavyo vya mada lengwa,
kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi na kukuza umilisi wa mawasiliano na ushirikiano,
kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,

kuandika insha isiyopungua maneno 200 inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na michezo kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lughaya kiubunifu. Katika kufanya hivi, atakuza ubunifu,
kukuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya masimulizi mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi?

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: wakati vifaa vya kidijitali vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.

Maadili mbalimbali kutegea tabia za wahusika wa insha.

Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha ya masimulizi na kuisambaza mtandaoni.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vivumishi vya idadi
skills.mastery: Gives the number word with the prefix of its noun from one to five (wawili, vitatu, minne, matano, mtoto mmoja) and without a prefix from six (ng'ombe sita), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Puts the prefix of another noun class on the number (vitabu watatu, wanafunzi viwili).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows the number words but not that they take the prefix of the noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ viko mezani." with "watatu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with a thing noun and the people form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha ngeli ya nomino: vitabu vitatu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the bare number (tatu, nne) without the prefix.
misconceptions.cause: In English the number never changes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Miti ___ imekatwa." with "nne" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the bare number word.
misconceptions.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha ngeli ya nomino. Miti minne.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Adds a class prefix to numbers from six (ng'ombe wasita).
misconceptions.cause: The child over-applies the rule for one to five.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baba ana ng'ombe ___." with "wasita" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with sita, saba or nane.
misconceptions.feedback: Kuanzia sita, nambari haichukui kiambishi cha ngeli: ng'ombe sita, vitabu saba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vivumishi viulizi
skills.mastery: Picks -ngapi (how many), -pi (which one) or gani (what kind) as the question needs, with the prefix of the noun (wangapi, vingapi, yupi, kipi, ipi), in 8 of 10 new questions.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the question word of another noun class (vitabu wangapi).
misconceptions.cause: The child uses the form for people for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ vimepotea?" with "wangapi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A question about things with the people form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi kiulizi huchukua ngeli ya nomino: wanafunzi wangapi, vitabu vingapi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the plural question word with one noun, or the singular with many (kitabu vipi).
misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ ni chako?" with "vipi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A question with one noun and the plural form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu kimoja: kipi. Vitabu vingi: vipi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Confuses -ngapi (how many) with gani (what kind), or the other way.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask what the question wants to know: a number, one of many, or a kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ulikula chakula ___ jana?" with "wangapi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A question about kind with -ngapi among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: -ngapi huuliza idadi, -pi huuliza ni ipi kati ya nyingi, gani huuliza aina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kutambua kivumishi kirejeshi amba-katika sentensi,
kutambua kivumishi kirejeshi amba-katika kifungu,
kueleza maana ya kivumishi lengwa kwa kurejelea vitu vilivyo katika mazingira yake (k.m: mgeni ambaye,mlango ambao, kiatu ambacho),

kujaza mapengo kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia kivumishi lengwa,
kutunga sentensi sahihi au vifungu vya maneno akitumia kivumishi lengwa.

skills.name: Tambua na tumia kivumishi kirejeshi amba-
skills.mastery: Gives amba- with the ending that agrees with the noun before it (mwalimu ambaye, watoto ambao, kitabu ambacho, miti ambayo) and does not leave amba- bare, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses amba- with the ending of another noun class (kitabu ambaye).
misconceptions.cause: The child uses ambaye for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ nilinunua ni kizuri." with "ambaye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A thing noun with ambaye among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Amba- huchukua mwisho unaolingana na ngeli ya nomino: kitabu ambacho, mwalimu ambaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular amba- form for many, or the plural for one (watoto ambaye).
misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Watoto ___ wanasoma ni werevu." with "ambaye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtu mmoja: ambaye. Watu wengi: ambao.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Leaves amba- without its ending (mama amba anauza).

example.question: Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the stem but not that it needs an ending.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu." with "amba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the bare stem amba.
misconceptions.feedback: Amba- haitumiki peke yake. Ina mwisho: ambaye, ambao, ambacho, ambayo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali,
kushiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili akiwa na wenzake,
kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu vitendawili vinavyotegwa katika jamii yao.

skills.name: Tambua vitendawili na uvitegue
skills.mastery: Picks the kitendawili (riddle) from a methali, a nahau and an ordinary sentence, and gives the answer to a known riddle, in 8 of 10 new items. Setting and guessing riddles aloud (outcome b) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.
misconceptions.cause: Both are short sayings.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a methali.
misconceptions.help: A riddle asks a hidden question and waits for the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.
misconceptions.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a nahau.
misconceptions.help: Can you guess an answer to it?
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
misconceptions.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.
misconceptions.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle with plausible answers.
misconceptions.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,
kutazama vielelezo vya video vinavyoonyesha usomaji fasaha wa makala (k.v. hotuba, habari,) au na wenzake,

kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa la mahusiano kati ya watu katika jamii (k.v. sahibu /rafiki/ mwandani, mpenzi, mwana, ndugu, jirani, mwenza) katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 80 kwa dakika) ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono zinazozingatia tamaduni),
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora.
key_inquiry_questions: Unaposoma kifungu ni mambo yapi unayozingatia ili kusoma ifaavyo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kujadiliana kuhusu vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kusoma.

sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii na wa kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.

skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha
skills.mastery: Names what a fluent reader does (clear sounds, a fitting speed, a fitting voice, a pause at the koma and the kikomo, a rising voice for a question, fitting gestures) and does not take speed or loudness for fluency, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a passage aloud (outcomes b to e) is judged by a teacher listening.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes fast reading for fluent reading, or very slow reading for careful reading.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Si haraka sana wala polepole sana

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks the best reader is the fastest.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on speed with extremes as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the listener can follow every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a loud voice for a fitting voice.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Sauti inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks louder is better.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on the voice with shouting and whispering as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the voice is clear and comfortable to listen to.
misconceptions.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on without a pause at the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads word after word and does not use the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on the pause at a koma or a kikomo.
misconceptions.help: Read the sentence aloud and listen to where the voice rests.
misconceptions.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua mitindo ya maandishi ya tarakilishi
skills.mastery: Names the styles of computer writing (herufi nzito, mlazo, saizi) and the actions kuhifadhi and kuchapisha, and does not take herufi kubwa for herufi nzito, in 8 of 10 new items. Typing a short text (outcome b) is a practical task.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Mixes herufi nzito, mlazo, saizi and rangi.
misconceptions.cause: The child has used the buttons but does not know their names.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Herufi zinazoegemea upande huitwa herufi ___." with "nzito" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Style names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi nzito zimenenepeshwa, herufi mlazo huegemea upande, saizi ni ukubwa wa herufi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes herufi kubwa or ndogo (capital or small letters) for a style such as herufi nzito.
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks big and bold are the same.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Herufi zilizonenepeshwa huitwa herufi ___." with "kubwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Kubwa among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi kubwa ni za mwanzo wa sentensi na majina. Herufi nzito ni zilizonenepeshwa, zinaweza kuwa ndogo au kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes the actions kuhifadhi (save), kuchapisha (print), kufuta (delete) and kufunga (close).

example.question: Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know what each button does.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___." with "kuchapisha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Several actions among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kuhifadhi ni kuweka kazi salama. Kuchapisha ni kutoa karatasi. Kufuta huondoa kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na tumia viwakilishi vya nafsi
skills.mastery: Picks mimi, wewe, yeye, sisi, ninyi or wao by who speaks, who is spoken to and who is spoken about, and by one or many, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

example.question: Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."

misconceptions.reveals: The question "Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."" with "Mimi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with speaker, listener and the one spoken about, all in the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Aliye anasema ni mimi, aliye anaambiwa ni wewe, anayezungumziwa ni yeye.

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular for many or the plural for one (sisi for mimi, ninyi for wewe).

misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama anamwambia mtoto, "___ unastahili sifa."" with "Ninyi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence to one child with the plural pronoun among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Wewe ni mmoja, ninyi ni wengi. Mimi ni mmoja, sisi ni wengi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia viwakilishi viashiria katika sentensi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi kwa zamu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: wanafunzi wanapokamilisha kazi yao.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia viwakilishi viashiria kwa kurejelea suala lengwa

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya viwakilishi viashiria ili kuvibainisha
kutambua viwakilishi viashiria katika matini mbalimbali
kutumia viwakilishi viashiria kwa usahihi katika sentensi
kuonea fahari matumizi ya viwakilishi viashiria katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia viwakilishi viashiria
skills.mastery: Uses a demonstrative that stands alone in place of the noun (Huyu ni rafiki yangu, Hivi ni vitabu), with the right class and number, and tells it from the demonstrative that follows a noun, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the demonstrative of another noun class (Hiki ni mti).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learned one form and uses it for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "___ ni mti wa mwembe." with "Hii" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several classes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi kiashiria hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachoonyeshwa: mti, huu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular demonstrative for many or the plural for one (Hawa ni mtoto).
misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "___ ni vitabu vya shule." with "Hiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu kimoja: hiki. Vitu vingi: hivi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Takes the demonstrative after a noun (kitabu hiki) for the pronoun that stands alone (Hiki ni kitabu).

example.question: Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake).

misconceptions.cause: The child sees the word hiki and does not look at whether a noun comes before it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake)." with "Kitabu hiki ni kizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two sentences with the same word, one with a noun before it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi husimama mahali pa nomino. Kikifuata nomino, ni kivumishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viwakilishi vya Idadi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake maana ya viwakilishi vya idadi huku akitoa mifano mwafaka,
kutambua viwakilishi vya idadi (k.v. chache, nyingi, tatu, kumi n.k.) katika ubao, kadi za maneno, mti wa maneno, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutambua viwakilishi vya idadi katika sentensi,
kutambua viwakilishi vya idadi katika kifungu kifupi,
kutumia viwakilishi vya idadi kutunga sentensi daftarini au katika kifaa cha kidijitali,
kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia viwakilishi viashiria ili kukamilisha sentensi kwenye daftari au katika kifaa cha kidijitali.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maneno yapi yanayotumika kuonyesha idadi ya vitu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu matumizi ya viwakilishi vya idadi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojibu swali dadisi lililopendekezwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutunga sentensi au kujazia mapengo
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia viwakilishi vya idadi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi kwa zamu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapokamilisha shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia viwakilishi vya idadi kwa kurejelea suala lengwa
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya viwakilishi vya nafsi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya viwakilishi vya idadi ili kuvitofautisha na viwakilishi vingine
kutambua viwakilishi vya idadi katika matini mbalimbali
kutumia viwakilishi vya idadi kwa usahihi katika sentensi ili kuboresha mawasiliano
kuonea fahari matumizi ya viwakilishi vya idadi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia viwakilishi vya idadi
skills.mastery: Uses a number word on its own in place of the noun (Wawili walichelewa, Vitatu nilimpa Wanjiru) with the prefix of the noun left out of the sentence, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the number with the prefix of another class (Viwili walichelewa for wawili).

example.question: Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets the pronoun takes the prefix of the noun it replaces.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)" with "Viwili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence about people with the form for things among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi cha idadi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino iliyoachwa: watu, wawili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the bare number (Tatu, Wili) with no prefix.

example.question: Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)

misconceptions.cause: In English the number never changes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)" with "Tatu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the bare number word.
misconceptions.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha nomino, hata ikisimama peke yake.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

sub_strands.sub_strand: Uakifishi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kutambua alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi,
kuakifisha sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni,
kuakifisha kifungu kifupi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni,
kuandika sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni ifaavyo katika daftari lake,
kuandika sentensi zenye alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini alama za kuakifisha hutumiwa katika maandishi?
Ni alama gani za uakifishi unazoweza kuzitumia kwa usahihi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: wanafunzi wanaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu uakifishi.
Ubunifu: wanapotunga sentensi wakitumia viakifishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kuakifisha sentensi au vifungu ifaavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni akirejelea suala lengwa.
Mawasiliano faafu: mwanafunzi anapotumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya uakifishaji na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kutambua alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi
kutumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni ifaavyo katika maandishi
kufurahia matumizi ya alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi

skills.name: Tumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni
skills.mastery: Chooses the sentence with the right alama ya hisi (!), ritifaa (') as in ng'ombe, and koloni (:) before a list, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Ends an exclamation or a command with a full stop or a question mark.
misconceptions.cause: The child ends every sentence the same way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Lo! Umefika mapema leo!" with "Lo. Umefika mapema leo." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence of surprise with a full stop among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Mshangao, furaha na amri kali huisha kwa alama ya hisi (!).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes ng'ombe or ng'ambo without the ritifaa (ngombe).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the ritifaa marks that ng is one sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mkulima ana ng'ombe watano." with "Mkulima ana ngombe watano." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the word spelt both ways.
misconceptions.feedback: Ritifaa (') huandikwa baada ya ng katika ng'ombe, ng'ambo, ng'ang'ana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a comma or a full stop where a koloni goes before a list.

example.question: Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi.
example.wrong_answer: Mama alinunua vitu hivi, mchele, sukari na chumvi.
example.correct_answer: Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know koloni introduces a list.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi." with "Mama alinunua vitu hivi, mchele, sukari na chumvi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence that announces a list with a comma among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Koloni (:) huja kabla ya orodha au maelezo yanayofuata.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kutambua maneno ya heshima (k.v. shehe, kasisi, padre, mwadhini, mheshimiwa, rais, mtawa) kwenye ubao, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kueleza maana ya maneno lengwa kama yanavyotumiwa katika mahusiano ya kila siku kati ya watu,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia maneno lengwa kwa usahihi,
kutazama maigizo ya watu wakitumia maneno ya heshima kwenye tarakilishi na video,
kuigiza mazungumzo mafupi akiwa na wenzake huku akitumia msamiati wa heshima.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno yapi ya heshima unayoyajua na unayoweza kutumia kurejelea watu tofauti?
Kutumia maneno ya heshima kuna umuhimu gani katika jamii?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi, video na projekta kutazama maigizo mafupi.
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo na mijadala.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza ipasavyo mazungumzo akitumia msamiati wa heshima.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu. Pia anapoheshimu nafasi za wenzake katika maigizo.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu kwa wenzake na kwa wakubwa wake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya heshima kuwarejelea watu maalum.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo mafupi akiwa na wenzake.
Masuala ya kiuana na jinsia: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno yanayorejelea uana na jinsia mahususi katika mawasiliano.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kuejelea suala lengwa.
Kujiendeleza kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anapotambua maneno ya heshima yanayotumika katika jamii yake kutoka kwa mzazi au mlezi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha matumizi ya maneno ya heshima, adabu na vyeo na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno ya heshima yanayotumiwa katika mawasiliano
kuonyesha uelewa wa maneno ya heshima kwa kuyatumia kwa usahihi katika mawasiliano
kuthamini kutumia maneno ya heshima katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na tumia maneno ya heshima
skills.mastery: Picks the polite word the situation needs (tafadhali to ask, asante to thank, samahani to say sorry, pole to comfort, karibu to welcome, shikamoo to greet an elder) and the sentence that is polite, in 8 of 10 new items. Using the words in daily talk (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses a polite word for the wrong job (asante to ask, pole to thank).

example.question: Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words but not what each is for.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."" with "asante" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A situation with all the polite words among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Tafadhali ni kuomba, asante ni kushukuru, samahani ni kuomba msamaha, pole ni kufariji, karibu ni kukaribisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the sentence without a polite word, as if a command were polite.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not notice the tone of a command.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?" with "Nisaidie kubeba mzigo huu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A request with and without tafadhali or naomba.
misconceptions.feedback: Ombi la heshima lina maneno kama tafadhali, naomba, samahani na asante.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake kuhusu hatua za kiusalama na maadili anayofaa kuzingatia anapotafuta na kusoma matini ya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu utunzaji wa vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika usomaji,
kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo),
kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga faili,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,
kusoma matini yanayojumuisha msamiati wa misimu kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutafuta maana za maneno mapyakwenye kamusi mtandaoni,
kusikiliza matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,
kutoa habari kwa muhtasari kuhusu matini aliyosoma na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma matini ya kidijitali kuna manufaa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi atapata hamu ya kutafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunzaji vifaa vya kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapojumuika na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowaruhusu wenzake kutoa maoni na kuheshimu maoni wanayotoa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama wa mitandaoni: mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali.
Kujiendeleza kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu misimu.
Udhibiti wa uwezo wa kutokea maafa: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu kuhusu mazingira na tabia nchi na namna yanavyoweza kusababisha maafa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua hatua za kiusalama katika matumiziya vifaa vya kidijitali anaposoma
kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye mada lengwa
kutumia vifaa ya kidijitali kwa urahisi ili kupata matini yanayolengwa
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake

skills.name: Zingatia hatua za kiusalama unapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Chooses the safe step when reading on a phone, tablet or computer (use a site an adult or teacher suggested, keep the password secret, ask an adult before an unknown link, log out) and not the unsafe one, in 8 of 10 new situations. Searching and opening a file (outcomes b and c) is a practical task for the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Shares a password or a personal detail with a friend or a stranger.
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks sharing is friendly.
misconceptions.reveals: Safe and unsafe steps for a password.
misconceptions.help: Ask who can use your account if they have the password.
misconceptions.feedback: Nenosiri ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki, ila mzazi au mlezi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Opens every link in a message from someone he does not know.

example.question: Ujumbe usiojulikana una kiungo cha zawadi. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child is curious and likes a prize.
misconceptions.reveals: An unknown message with a link.
misconceptions.help: Ask who sent it and whether you asked for it.
misconceptions.feedback: Viungo kutoka kwa watu usiowajua vinaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuvifungua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Searches on any site and gives details to a site that asks for them.

example.question: Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma. Utumie tovuti ipi?
example.wrong_answer: Tovuti inayotaka jina na nambari ya simu yangu
example.correct_answer: Tovuti ya shule au maktaba iliyopendekezwa na mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask who runs the site.
misconceptions.reveals: Safe and unsafe sites.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the site needs your personal details to read.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi, na usitoe maelezo yako binafsi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua Rasmi (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kutambua barua rasmi kwenye kielelezo cha barua rasmi iliyochapishwa au kwenye tarakilishi,

kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi (k.v. anwani ya mwandishi [jina, sanduku la posta, tarehe], anwani ya mpokeaji [cheo, sanduku la posta], mtajo, mada ya barua, mwili, hitimisho, sahihi na jina la mwandishi),

kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu akiomba kujiunga na klabu shuleni(k.v. vile skauti, mazingira,kilimo na muziki), akishirikiana na wenzake darasani, kwa hati za mkono au kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia muundowa uandishi wa barua rasmi,
kuandika barua rasmi katika daftariakiwa peke yake,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu umuhimu wa barua rasmi katikamawasiliano.
key_inquiry_questions: Barua rasmi ni barua ya aina gani
Unazingatia nini unapoandika baruarasmi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili barua rasmi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika barua rasmi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: anapowaza kuhusu kanuni za barua rasmi na kupanga aya.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji kama kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapozingatia maoni ya wenzake wakati wa mijadala.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kama anavyoagizwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mawasiliano faafu: mwanafunzi anapotumia barua rasmi kuwasiliana.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya barua rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotekeleza shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake darasani.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika barua rasmi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua barua rasmi kwa kuzingatia muundo wake
kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ili kuvizingatia katika uandishi
kuandika barua rasmi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia umuhimu wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua muundo na vipengele vya barua rasmi
skills.mastery: Names the parts of a barua rasmi (anwani ya mwandikaji kulia, tarehe, anwani ya mwandikiwa kushoto, salamu, kichwa, mwili, mwisho "Wako mwaminifu", sahihi na jina) and tells it from a friendly letter, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the letter (outcome c) is composition marking.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Puts a part of the letter in the wrong place (salamu for kichwa, tarehe for jina).

example.question: Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua.

misconceptions.cause: The child has met the parts but not what each holds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua." with "mwili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Parts asked by what they hold.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa hutaja mada, salamu humwamkia mwandikiwa, mwili una ujumbe, na mwisho una sahihi na jina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the sender's address on the left and the receiver's on the right.

example.question: Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi.

misconceptions.cause: The child swaps the two addresses.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi." with "kushoto" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Left and right among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani ya mwandikaji iko juu kulia. Anwani ya mwandikiwa iko kushoto, chini ya tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the greeting, ending or words of a friendly letter in a formal one.
misconceptions.cause: The child writes to a headteacher as to a friend.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwisho wa barua rasmi huwa "Wako ___,"." with "mpenzi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A formal and a friendly ending among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha na maneno ya heshima, kama "Wako mwaminifu,".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the parts of the letter in the wrong order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?
example.wrong_answer: Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho
example.correct_answer: Anwani, tarehe, salamu, kichwa, mwili, mwisho

misconceptions.cause: The child does not picture the page from top to bottom.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?" with "Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two orderings among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua huanza na anwani na tarehe juu, kisha salamu, kichwa, mwili na mwisho chini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya YA-YA (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya YA-YA katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi kwenye sentensi (k.m. maji, maziwa, mate, marashi na maskani),
kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua majina gani ya vitu visivyohesabika?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA ipasavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino na ngeli zake.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Mawasiliano faafu: mwanafunzi anapowasiliana kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika umoja na wingi ifaavyo.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika umoja na wingi ifaavyo zinazohusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya sarufi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya YA – YA katika sentensi
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA –YA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya YA-YA kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to YA-YA (maji, maziwa, mafuta, mate, machozi, manukato; they begin with ma- and have no singular), gives ya- as the subject prefix, and does not use li- or a prefix of another class, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses li- with a ma- noun because it starts with ma- (maji limeisha).
misconceptions.cause: The child learned that ma- goes with li-, which is true only for the plural of nouns that have a singular.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maji ___meisha kisimani." with "li" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Je, kuna neno jiji, au jimaji?" Maji has no singular.
misconceptions.feedback: Maji ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA. Hupatana na ya-: maji yameisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses u-, i-, zi- or vi- with a YA-YA noun.
misconceptions.cause: The child uses the prefix of the class he knows best.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "i" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a- as for a person or animal (maziwa ameichacha).
misconceptions.cause: The child treats the noun like a living thing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "a" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with a- among the options for a thing noun.
misconceptions.feedback: A- ni ya watu na wanyama. Maziwa ni kitu, na hupatana na ya-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun of another class as a YA-YA noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?

misconceptions.cause: The child cannot yet tell YA-YA nouns by their agreement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?" with "kitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- na hazina umoja, kama maji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Methali Kufikia mwisho wa (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kutambua methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano (kama vile; umoja ni nguvu utengano ni udhaifu, jifya moja haliinjikichungu, kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa, kinga na kinga ndio moto huwaka n.k.) katika chati, ubao na vyombo vyakidijitali,
kutoa mifano ya methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika jamii,
kusikiliza methali za umoja na ushirikiano zikitumiwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake maana na matumizi ya methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano,
kulinganisha methali na maana yake,
kukamilisha methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mazungumzo akishirikiana na wenzake, kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia vyombo vya kidijitali,
kusakura mtandaoni kwa kusaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake ili kupata methali zaidi zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano na matumizi ya methali hizo,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu methali alizozipata mtandaoni ili wajengane kimaarifa.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nini umuhimu wa methali katika jamii?
Ni methali gani unazozijua kuhusu umoja na ushirikiano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kujadili methali kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu matumizi ya methali.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia methali kujieleza.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua methali.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anachangamkia maoni ya wenzake.
Umoja: wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi katika vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anapokamilisha methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mazungumzo akishirikiana na wenzake.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza methali za umoja na ushirikiano zikitumiwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya matumizi ya methali na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
