outcomes.text: kutambua methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika matini
kueleza maana na matumizi ya methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja naushirikiano katika jamii
kutumia methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mawasiliano
kuchangamkia matumizi ya methalizinazohimiza umoja na ushirikiano

skills.name: Tambua na eleza maana ya methali za umoja na ushirikiano
skills.mastery: Completes a methali about unity and working together (umoja ni nguvu, kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa, mkono mmoja haulei mwana, wengi wape) and says what it means, and does not read it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using a methali when speaking (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Reads the methali word for word.

example.question: Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii hufurahia matunda yake baadaye

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know that a methali carries a second meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what lesson the methali teaches.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the lesson of another methali.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Vitu vidogo vikiongezwa polepole huwa vingi

misconceptions.cause: The child knows methali but swaps their lessons.
misconceptions.reveals: The meaning of a different methali as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the words say about little and little.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Completes the methali with a word that does not belong to it.
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the beginning but not the end.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap where a plausible wrong ending is an option.
misconceptions.help: Say the whole methali again from the beginning.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kujadili ukwapi na utao katika shairi,
kutambua ukwapi na utao katika shairi kwenye ubao, chati, vitabu au vyombo vya kidijitali,
kusoma shairi akizingatia ukwapi na utao,
kujirekodi akisoma aina za mashairi lengwa akitumia vyombo vya kidijitali ili kuweza kujirekebisha anakokosea,
kutofautisha mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwenye ubao, chati, vitabu au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia katika matini mbalimbali,
kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,
kujadili ujumbe kwenye shairi waliyoyasoma,
kujibu maswali yanayotokana na mashairi aliyoyasoma,
kuandika ujumbe alioupata katika mojawapo ya mashairi aliyoyasoma na kuujadili na wenzake darasani.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kuna tofauti gani kati ya mashairi mbalimbali?

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili aina lengwa za mashairi.

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma mashairi kwa mahadhi yafaayo. Pia anapoweza kufafanua ipasavyo ujumbe wa shairi alilolisoma.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua aina za shairi.

Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia katika matini mbalimbali akisaidiana na mzazi au mlezi.

outcomes.text: kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha
kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo

skills.name: Tambua aina za mashairi: tathnia, tathlitha, tarbia
skills.mastery: Names the kind of poem by the lines in a stanza (tathnia: two, tathlitha: three, tarbia: four), and names the two parts of a line (ukwapi, the first, and utao, the second), without swapping them or counting mizani instead, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a poem for its message (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Gives the name of another kind of poem for the number of lines (tathlitha for tathnia).
misconceptions.cause: The child has the names but not the numbers behind them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___." with "tathlitha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The number of lines asked with all three names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Tathnia ni mishororo miwili, tathlitha mitatu na tarbia minne. Jina linaonyesha idadi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the kind of a stanza shown without counting its lines.

example.question: Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."

misconceptions.cause: The child guesses from the look of the stanza.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."" with "tathlitha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A short stanza with the three names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Hesabu mishororo kwanza. Mistari miwili ni tathnia, mitatu ni tathlitha, minne ni tarbia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Swaps ukwapi (the first part of a line) and utao (the second).

example.question: Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the two names but not their order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "utao" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Both names among the options for the first or the second part.
misconceptions.feedback: Mshororo hugawanyika katika sehemu mbili: ukwapi ni ya kwanza, utao ni ya pili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives vina or mizani for the parts of a line.

example.question: Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes the parts of a line with its sounds and counts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "vina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with vina and mizani.
misconceptions.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, na mizani ni silabi. Vipande vya mshororo ni ukwapi na utao.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Maelezo (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)

kukuza umilisi wa ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya maelezo na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya maelezo ina sifa gani?

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.

skills.name: Tambua insha ya wasifu, masimulizi na maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells a short text that describes a person (wasifu), one that tells events in order (masimulizi) and one that explains how something is done or what it is (maelezo), in 8 of 10 new short texts.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes a text that describes a person (wasifu) for a story (masimulizi).

example.question: Kifungu kinaelezea sura, tabia na maisha ya mtu. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both kinds can mention a person.
misconceptions.reveals: Short texts: one describing a person, one telling events.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the text tells what happened in order, or tells who someone is.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya wasifu humwelezea mtu: sura yake, tabia yake na maisha yake. Masimulizi husimulia matukio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a text that explains how something is done (maelezo) for a story.

example.question: Kifungu kinaeleza hatua za kupika uji. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a sequence in both.
misconceptions.reveals: A recipe-like text and a story.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the writer says "what happened" or "how to do it".
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu. Masimulizi husimulia tukio lililotokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a story of events for a description of a person.

kukariri akishirikiana na wenzake, shairi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa na mahadhi mbalimbali,
kutamka maneno yaliyoundwa kutokana na sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng katika shairi,
kutambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia (k.m. jinsia, ubaguzi, mtoto wa kiume, mtoto wa kike, usawa, heshima na uwajibikaji),
kutumia msamiati uliotumika katika shairi kutunga sentensi sahihi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusakura mtandaoni, akishirikiana na wenzake, ili kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,
kujadili ujumbe katika shairi waliloliimba,
kujibu maswali yanayotokana na shairi alilosikiliza, aliloimba au kukariri,
kusoma mashairi katika vitabu na mtandaoni ili kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji.

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya PA-KU-MU kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Matches the word of place and the verb in PA-KU-MU: pa- for a particular place (pale pana), ku- for a far or general place (kule kuna), mu- or m- for inside (mle mna), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses the wrong one of pa-, ku-, mu- for the place (kule pana).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the word of place (pale, kule, humu).
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." with "pana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with pale, kule or humu and all three forms among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Pale huchukua pa-, kule huchukua ku-, humu na mle huchukua mu- (m-).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the prefix of the noun (una, ina) where the place needs pa-, ku- or mu-.
misconceptions.cause: The child follows the noun and not the place.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." with "ina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with u- and i- forms.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika ngeli ya mahali, kitenzi hupatana na mahali (pa-, ku-, mu-), si na nomino.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua visawe na makundi ya maneno yenye maana sawa
skills.mastery: Picks the word with almost the same meaning (furaha-bashasha, haraka-upesi) and the group of four words that all share one meaning, and does not pick the opposite, a related word or a group with one opposite in it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite where the same meaning is asked.
misconceptions.cause: The child links furaha and huzuni because they go together.
misconceptions.reveals: A synonym question with the opposite as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the two words mean the same.
misconceptions.feedback: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word about the same topic but with a different meaning.
misconceptions.cause: The child picks what goes with the word, not what means the same.
misconceptions.reveals: A related word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Could you swap the two words in a sentence and keep the same meaning?
misconceptions.feedback: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.
misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
misconceptions.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Say what each word means.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a group that has one opposite or unrelated word among the synonyms.

example.question: Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?

misconceptions.cause: The child checks the first words of the group and not every word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?" with "bashasha, huzuni, raha, tabasamu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A group with three synonyms and one opposite.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila neno la kundi lazima liwe na maana sawa. Huzuni ni kinyume cha furaha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na elewa mchezo wa kuigiza
skills.mastery: Tells a play from a story (names of speakers, words spoken, directions in brackets), says what a word in the play means, and answers questions about it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Reads the words in brackets (what to do on stage) as words a character says.

example.question: Maelekezo ya jukwaani katika igizo ni yapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads a play as a story.
misconceptions.reveals: A play with brackets and spoken lines.
misconceptions.help: Brackets tell the actor what to do, not what to say.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yaliyo kwenye mabano ni maelekezo ya kitendo, si maneno ya mhusika. Hayasomwi kama mazungumzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell a play from a story.

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni igizo?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a short text and does not look at the form.
misconceptions.reveals: A play and a story on the same event.
misconceptions.help: Look for the speaker names with a colon.
misconceptions.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a character who did not say the line.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not follow the names before the colons.
misconceptions.reveals: A who-said-it question.
misconceptions.help: Find the line and read the name before it.
misconceptions.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mtu anayesema maneno yaliyofuata.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a wrong detail of the play (the place, the thing bought).
misconceptions.cause: The child remembers a place named near the question.
misconceptions.reveals: A where-or-what question with another detail of the play.
misconceptions.help: Find the line where it is said.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye igizo na utafute mstari unaotaja jibu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong meaning of a word in the play.

example.question: Neno "kuandamana" lina maana gani katika igizo?

misconceptions.cause: The child guesses from the look of the word.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question for a word in the play.
misconceptions.help: Read the line where the word is used and think who goes with whom.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na mstari lilimotumika katika igizo. Soma mstari huo tena.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitenzi katika hali ya kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia kutendeana, kutendesha na kutendua
skills.mastery: Tells the three verb forms apart (kutendeana: each does it for the other, as in kuandikiana; kutendesha: makes someone do it, as in kuimbisha; kutendua: undoes it, as in kufungua) and picks the one a sentence needs, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Keeps the simple verb where a longer form is needed (hupika for hupikiana).

example.question: Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the verb and not what the sentence says about who does it for whom.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)" with "hupika" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Nani anampikia nani?" If each cooks for the other, the verb needs -ana.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi cha kawaida hakionyeshi kwamba kila mmoja anamtendea mwenzake. Kutendeana: hupikiana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the verb for one doing it for another (hupikia) where each does it for the other (hupikiana).

example.question: Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi.

misconceptions.cause: The child leaves out -ana.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi." with "huandikia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence in which two people do the same for each other.
misconceptions.feedback: Wawili wakitendeana, kitenzi huishia -ana: huandikiana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a verb form that does not fit the meaning (huandikisha for huandikiana).

example.question: Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes the endings -ana, -isha and -ua.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)" with "huimbiana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with each ending and a gloss in brackets.
misconceptions.feedback: -ana ni kila mmoja kwa mwenzake, -isha ni kumfanya mtu atende, na -ua ni kufanya kinyume.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kutambua miktadha mbalimbali kunakotumiwa lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi (k.v. ofisini, hospitalini, nyumbani, sokoni),
kusikiliza mazungumzo rasmi na yasiyo rasmi kwa kutazama maigizo kwenye vyombo vya kidijitali (k.v. video, rununu, runinga, tarakilishi),
kushiriki katika maigizo ya mazungumzo ya miktadha rasmi na yasiyo rasmi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kushiriki katika mazungumzo rasmi na yasiyo rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v, mambo yanayosababisha msongo wa mawazo unao sababishwa na ajali za barabarani n.k),
kutambua nidhamu ya lugha inayozingatiwa katika mazingira rasmi (k.m lugha ya heshima na adabu anapowasiliana).
key_inquiry_questions: Ni wapi katika shughuli zetu za kila siku tunaitumia lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi?
Ni nini kinachofanya mazungumzo yawe rasmi au yasiyo rasmi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake darasani.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni na kushiriki katika mazungumzo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza na kutazama mazungumzo.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu wenzake wakati wa kuigiza na kushiriki katika mazungumzo.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapotambua miktadha tofauti ya matumizi ya lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotumia lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi katika miktadha faafu ili kuimarisha mahusiano ya kijamii.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusikiliza anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya ya akili na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi katika mawasiliano ili kuitofautisha
kutumia lugha katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi ili kufanikisha mawasiliano
kuchangamkia matumizi ya lugha katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi kuimarisha maadili yafaayo

skills.name: Tofautisha lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi
skills.mastery: Tells formal language (for a meeting, a leader, a letter) from informal language (for friends and home) and picks the sentence that fits the person and the place, in 8 of 10 new items. Speaking in each context (outcome b, in full) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Calls formal language informal, or informal language formal.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not look at who is speaking to whom.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___." with "rasmi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A greeting between friends and a greeting to a leader.
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha rasmi ni ya heshima na ya viongozi. Lugha isiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki na nyumbani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses slang or casual words with a teacher, a leader or at a meeting.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu mkuu, naomba ruhusa ya kuondoka mapema.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the way he talks to friends everywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu." with "Nipe ruhusa tu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A request to a leader with a casual version among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa mwalimu, kiongozi au mkutano rasmi tunatumia maneno ya heshima.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses very formal words with a friend or a sister at home.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks formal words are always better.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani." with "Naomba kibali cha kuanza mchezo." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A friendly invitation next to a formal one.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa rafiki au ndugu nyumbani, lugha ya kawaida inafaa. Lugha rasmi kupita kiasi inasikika ya ajabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kutambua matini zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni,
kusoma matini alizochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,
kutolea wenzake muhtasari wa kile alichosoma kwenye matini ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,
kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambazo wamesoma kwa kuzingatia ukuzaji wa msamiati.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni habari zipi unazopenda kusoma kwenye matini?
Unazingatia nini unapochagua matini za kusoma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposimulia na kujadiliana na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi na mtandao kupata matini za kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kuzisoma.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza matini anazosoma.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu alichosoma.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kusoma matini zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotambua matini zinazomvutia mtandaoni na kuzisoma.

kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa
kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini ili kupanua mawazo yake

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Maelezo (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kueleza maudhui kutokana na mada ya insha ya maelezo,
kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea. Pia akizingatie anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v athari za msongo wa mawazo kwa sababu ya ajali za barabarani na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini),
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani unayoweza kuwasilisha unapoandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia wakati wa kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi pamoja.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia ujuzi wa kidijitali kuandika insha ya maelezo.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya ya akili na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha, mawasiliano
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wenye mapambo ya lugha

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vinyume vya Vivumishi (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kutambua vinyume vya vivumishi(k.v. zuri- baya, kali-butu, refu- fupi) katika chati, kadi za maneno, kapu maneno, mti maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutafuta vinyume vya vivumishi kwa kurejelea orodha ya vivumishi alivyopewa,
kutalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vivumishi,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vivumishi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vivumishi vipi unavyoweza kutambua vinyume vyake?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kazi ya vikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.

Elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anapotalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vivumishi.

outcomes.text: kutambua vinyume vya vivumishi katika matini
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vivumishi

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vinyume vya vivumishi
skills.mastery: Gives the true opposite of an adjective (mrefu-mfupi, mzito-mwepesi, mwerevu-mjinga) in the form that agrees with the noun, and does not repeat the word or pick a different adjective, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Repeats the word as its own opposite.

example.question: Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the word lakini that signals a contrast.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___." with "mzito" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with lakini and the same word among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume ni neno la maana ya upande wa pili, si neno lilelile.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a different adjective that is not the opposite (mdogo for mfupi).

example.question: Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child picks a word from the same field (size) without checking it is the exact opposite.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___." with "mdogo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A word with a near neighbour of meaning among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi. Mdogo ni kinyume cha mkubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the opposite without the prefix of the noun (refu for mrefu, jinga for mjinga).

example.question: Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the opposite to fit the noun when it does not change, or leaves out the prefix when it must.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___." with "kilaini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with and without the prefix.
misconceptions.feedback: Vivumishi vingi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino (mjinga, wachache). Vingine hubaki kama vilivyo (laini, moto).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Sitiari za Tabia (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake maana ya sitiari,
kutambua sitiari za tabia (k.v. yeye ni sungura, yeye ni fisi, yeye ni kasuku, mimi ni kobe safarini) katika vitabu, matini, chati na vyombo vya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutoa mifano ya sitiari za tabia akisaidiana na mwenzake,
kueleza maana ya sitiari mbalimbali,
kutumia sitiari katika sentensi .
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani unayoweza kutumia kulinganisha kitu na kingine kwa njia ya moja kwa moja?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi ya vikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotambua sitiari katika matini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua sitiari.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake.
Umoja: anaposhirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kukabiliana na ugaidi: mwanafunzi anapotoa mifano ya stiari akirejelea suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu: mwanafunzi anaposaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi, kutunga sentensi mbalimbali akitumia sitiari za tabia na anapotambua sitiari za tabia katika matini.

Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusikiliza na kuzungumza anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kujadili dhana ya sitiari ili kuitofautisha na dhana zingine za lugha
kutambua sitiari za tabia katika matini mbalimbali ili kuzibainisha
kutumia sitiari za tabia kwa usahihi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
kufurahia matumizi ya sitiari katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na tumia sitiari za tabia
skills.mastery: Completes a sitiari about behaviour (Kamau ni nyuki, mkuu wa shule ni simba, mwenzako ni kinyonga) and picks the sentence that is a sitiari and not a tashbihi (with kama) or a plain statement, in 8 of 10 new items. Using sitiari in speech (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Names the wrong animal for the behaviour (kobe for a hard worker).

example.question: Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not link the animal with the behaviour it stands for.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___." with "kobe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A behaviour with several animals among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila mnyama hutumika kuonyesha tabia: nyuki (bidii), simba (ujasiri), kobe (polepole), kinyonga (kubadilika), mbweha (ujanja), tausi (kujionyesha).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a sentence with kama (a tashbihi) for a sitiari.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not tell the two figures apart.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ni kama simba." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sitiari and a tashbihi on the same subject.
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia "kama". Sitiari husema moja ni lingine bila "kama".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the sitiari word for word (the teacher really has a lion).
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the sentence as a plain statement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ana simba." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sitiari beside a sentence with the verb kuwa na.
misconceptions.feedback: Sitiari haisemi mtu ana mnyama. Inasema mtu ni mnyama kwa tabia yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kutambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini zilizohifadhiwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali (k.v. kutofuta kazi za wenzake zilizohifadhiwa katika vifaa vya kidijitali) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini za mtandaoni (k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo, kutowasiliana na watu usiowajua, kutofichua nywila yako kwa wenzake),
kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,
kutafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni, kusimulia wenzake habari alizosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Unakumbuka habari gani uliyoisoma mtandaoni?
Ni hatua gani za kiusalama unazozingatia unapotafuta habari mtandaoni?
sub_strands.core_competences: Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi atapata hamu ya kutafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
sub_strands.values: Uwajibikaji: katika utunzaji wa vifaa vya kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama wa mitandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini za mtandaoni na anapotambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake.
Usalama na ulinzi: mwanafunzi anapofahamu namna anavyoweza kujizuia na ulaghai wa mtandaoni kwa kutowasiliana na watu asiowajua na kutoa habari kwa mwalimu au mzazi endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na ugaidi na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Masimulizi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kujadili mada na vidokezo vya insha ili kuvitumia katika kuandika insha yake,
kuelezea maudhui atakayotumia kuandikia insha ya masimulizi,

kuandika insha ya masimulizi (k.v. kuhusu ugaidi, uhalifu, ajali, safari n.k) isiyopungua maneno 200 akizingatia mada, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka, lugha ya kiubunifu na urefu unaotarajiwa. Pia azingatie aina mbalimbali za maneno, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, na nyakati ili kejenga picha dhahiri ya anachokiandikia daftarini,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini na kumwelekeza.

skills.name: Tambua na tumia hali ya masharti
skills.mastery: Uses -ki-, -sipo- and -nge- for a condition (Ukisoma, utafaulu; Usipomwagilia, itakauka; Ningekuwa tajiri, ningejenga) and does not use a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) in its place, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) where a condition marker (-ki-, -nge-) is needed.
misconceptions.cause: The child knows tenses and not the condition marker.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani." with "Ulisoma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with if in the meaning and tense forms among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Sharti linaonyeshwa kwa -ki-, -sipo- au -nge-, si kwa -li-, -na- au -ta-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses -sipo- (do not) where the condition is to do (-ki-).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the whole sentence for meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka." with "wasipofanya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A condition whose result only makes sense if it is positive.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima. Kama matokeo ni mazuri, sharti ni la kufanya (-ki-).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the tense marker (-ta-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?

misconceptions.cause: The child finds a marker in the verb but picks the wrong one.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?" with "-ta-" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with both -ki- and -ta- and both in the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Ta- huonyesha wakati ujao. Ki- huonyesha sharti.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the person prefix (u-, a-, ni-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the first marker in the verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?" with "-a-" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A verb with a person prefix and a condition marker.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi cha mtu (u-, a-, ni-) hakionyeshi sharti. Sharti ni -ki-, -sipo-, -nge-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kujieleza kwa Ufasaha (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbali ambazo huweza kusimuliwa kuhusiana na mambo na hali za maisha (k.v. hadithi za mashujaa, shughuli za sikukuu za kitaifa, usomaji wa bajeti, ulipaji wa ushuru, hekaya),
kusikiliza kisa cha kisimulizi kuhusu mada lengwa kutoka kwa mgeni mwalikwa, tepurekoda, video na tarakilishi ili kupata sifa za usimulizi mzuri,

kusimulia kisa kuhusiana na mada fulani akizingatia mtiririko wa matukio, kanuni za kisarufi, kupanda na kushuka kwa sauti, ishara za uso, viziada lugha, tasfida, na wakati ili kuufanya utungo wake uvutie,
wa mawazo, mfuatano wa kuuliza na kujibu maswali kutokana na visa vilivyosimuliwa darasani.

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kusimulia kisa kuhusu mambo mbalimbali katika jamii.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposimama mbele ya hadhira na kusimulia kisa.

skills.mastery: Gives the big form (ji-) and the small form (kiji-) of nouns that begin with ki- (kitabu: jitabu, kijitabu) and their plurals (majitabu, vijitabu), in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Swaps the big form (ji-) and the small form (kiji-).
misconceptions.cause: The child learned both forms but not which is for big and which for small.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." with "kijitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A big or small noun with both forms among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukubwa hupata ji-, udogo hupata kiji-. Kijitabu ni kitabu kidogo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the plain plural (vitabu) where the big or small form is asked.
misconceptions.cause: The child confuses a big thing with many things.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." with "vitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the plain plural.
misconceptions.feedback: Vitabu ni wingi wa kitabu. Kitabu kikubwa sana ni jitabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves the noun unchanged (kitabu for jitabu or kijitabu).
misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that size changes the noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kisu kidogo huitwa ___." with "kisu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the plain noun.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukubwa na udogo hubadilisha mwanzo wa nomino: kisu, kijisu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the singular where the plural is asked.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the word wingi.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jitabu" ni ___." with "jitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the singular.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa jitabu ni majitabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kutaja nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo kwa kutumia kadi maneno, mti maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. jani (jijani - kijani), jiko (jijiko -kijijiko),
kushiriki kwenye mjadala wa kutambua viambishi vinavyotumika kudhihirisha ukubwa na udogo wa nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ji-,
kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa na udogo,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino hizo katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nomino gani zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji-unazozijua?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu mada hii.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya udogo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali ya wastani na udogo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia udogo na ukubwa kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ukubwa na udogo wa nomino na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.
